One anecdote on shotguns & close range effectiveness; years back I read about Vietnam shotgun ammo tests. The conclusion was that any load had equivalent performance out to ~7yds. Beyond that heavier weight shot, buck or slugs were required for knockdown. So basically dove & quail field loads were as effective as #4 buck at short range due the the shot bundle staying more or less together up to that point.
